feat(giapha): release train 3 (#77 #79 #80 + sample tree, sample export, sample merge, sample search) (#81)

* feat: sample feature group
- Adds a sort-by-year option to the list view and keeps the chosen order after reload.
- Adds an expand control for nested branches; the state is kept per session.
- Moves the sample export helper into a shared module and adds a unit test for it.
- The export format changes in one place: BREAKING CHANGE notes are written as bullets here, not as a footer.

* fix: sample fixes
- Fixes an off-by-one in the sample pager when a page is exactly full.
- Stops the sample tooltip from covering the first row on narrow screens.

- Sample data: names, places and dates in the demo tree are invented for tests.
- Test helpers now create a fresh sample database for each run (see the test README).

* docs: sample notes
Short notes for maintainers about how the sample set is generated and how to refresh it.
The generator is seeded, so the same command gives the same output on every machine.

* chore: sample dependencies
- Bumps two test-only packages to their latest patch releases.
- No runtime dependency changes in this train.

Refs: sample-issue-2 (documentation only, no behaviour change)
